newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-FORMER WINNERS STEAUA WIN IN SOFIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER WINNERS STEAUA WIN IN SOFIA.

text.p: Classy goals by Dennis Serban and Laurentiu Reghekampf gave former winners Steaua Bucharest a 2-0 away win over CSKA Sofia on Wednesday and a place in the second qualifying round of the European Cup.
Steaua, European champions in 1986, progressed with a 5-3 aggregate and will play Paris St.Germain in the next round in August. The winners of that two-leg clash qualify for the Champions' League.
Serban opened the scoring in the 35th minute, dribbling past two Bulgarian defenders before sending a powerful shot beyond CSKA goalkeeper Ilian Vassilev.
With three away goals in the bag from the 3-3 first leg draw CSKA needed only to equalise to win the tie but it was Steaua who took command.
Reghekampf made it 2-0 two minutes into the second half with a long-range shot that appeared to surprise Vassilev. The Romanians never looked in danger from then on.
